tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Nothing sits directly on white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and menus only — one step up from surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and input borders. Dividers are line, never grey.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, tasting notes and captions. Never for something a reader must act on.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The only accent, rationed to one element per view: a primary button, a price, or the eyebrow rule.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Label colour on an ember fill. Never put ink on ember.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links — an alias of ember, so a theme that moves ember moves links.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces is for display only. Never set body copy in it.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Karla carries everything that is not a page title.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings. Never below this step.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rested four days, ground to order.
styles.usage: All prose, menu items and controls.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Labels, metadata and tasting notes. The only style that may be letter-spaced.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The one uppercase style, always beside the 2px ember rule.

radius.note: Soft but never round — except pills.

shadow.note: Two elevations exist. Most things have neither.
